APK of **NewPipe Perle**, which installs next to the official NewPipe (app id `org.schabi.newpipe.continuous.perle`).

- **Perle**: the most viewed videos of every channel, equally weighted, for all subscriptions or a single folder.
- **Cast to TV** (DLNA/UPnP): send videos to smart TVs (e.g. Samsung Tizen) on the same Wi-Fi network, up to 720p. See `docs/DLNA_CAST.md`.

From perle-v2 on, every release is signed with the same key, so updates install over the previous version and keep your data.
To move your subscriptions and folders from the official NewPipe: Settings → Backup and restore → Export database in NewPipe, then Import database in NewPipe Perle.
